title: Counting down with while
description: You can follow a changing value through repeated condition checks.

steps.description: You start countdown at 3. The while condition permits an iteration whenever countdown is greater than zero.
Each pass prints countdown and then subtracts one. The next condition check uses that updated value.

steps.question: Will the loop print zero?
steps.answer: No. When countdown reaches zero, the condition is False and execution leaves the loop.

steps.description: You see 3, 2 and 1 followed by the liftoff message. The final print runs after the loop finishes.
